entities.summary: The Royal Aircraft Factory F.E.1 was designed and built in 1910 by the pioneer designer Geoffrey de Havilland. He used it to teach himself to fly during late 1910. After De Havilland was appointed assistant designer and test pilot at the Army Balloon Factory at Farnborough in December 1910 the War Office bought the aircraft for £400. the aircraft was given the designation F.E.1
